text: {"components": [{"type": "claim", "quote": "Le domaine de la sécurité (safety) joue un rôle majeur.", "gist": "Safety is considered a major domain by DETEC."}, {"type": "obligation", "quote": "promouvoir la sécurité", "gist": "Promote safety"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "Il soutient le développement d’une culture de la sécurité concernant les transports dans leur ensemble (sur terre, sur l'eau et dans les airs), mais aussi l’utilisation, le transport et la distribution de l’énergie ainsi que les infrastructures de communication.", "gist": "Supports development of safety culture across all transport modes and energy/communication infrastructure."}, {"type": "number", "quote": "2003", "gist": "Year when CASO was established"}, {"type": "entity", "quote": "CASO (Civil Aviation Safety Office)", "gist": "Civil Aviation Safety Office"}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "le DETEC a instauré le CASO, le chargeant d’amener la sécurité dans l’aviation civile suisse à un niveau élevé.", "gist": "DETEC established CASO to raise civil aviation safety to a high level in Switzerland."}, {"type": "claim", "quote": "le domaine d’intervention du CASO a aussi englobé le rail et la navigation.", "gist": "CASO's scope later expanded to include rail and navigation."}]}
